bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches, or small bags up to 4.5 × 6.5 × 3 inches, may enter after inspection. Backpacks are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue stands near Acrisure Stadium and several paid North Shore lots and garages; availability and rates depend on the event.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
